The GifOS port vendors the published UMD bundle (standalone name
jscadModeling) and wraps it in a script editor + WebGL orbit view.
openjscad.xyz's Ace editor, file-drop of .scad, and the OpenSCAD
translator are not shipped. Rebuild with:

  node apps/openjscad/vendor.mjs
